content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for PMMMH Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for PMMMH Delhi Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Senior Resident posts at Pt. Madan Mohan Malaviya Hospital is scheduled for 24 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they report on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for Senior Resident posts at PMMMH Delhi?
faq.answer: Pt. Madan Mohan Malaviya Hospital is recruiting for a total of 10 Senior Resident posts across various specialities. This includes positions in Radiology, Anesthesia, Microbiology, Obs & Gynae, Medicine, and Surgery.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree with a PG Degree/Diploma or an equivalent qualification recognized by the Medical Council of India. Registration with the Delhi Medical Council is also mandatory.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to the Senior Resident positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Senior Resident posts is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable for persons with disabilities as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Senior Resident posts will receive a salary as per Level-11 of the 7th Pay Commission. This ensures a competitive remuneration package.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the PMMMH Delhi Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for the Senior Resident posts at Pt. Madan Mohan Malaviya Hospital. This applies to all categories, including General, OBC, SC, and ST candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these Senior Resident vacancies?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Resident posts at PMMMH Delhi will be based on a Walk-in Interview. Candidates will be assessed based on their qualifications and performance during the interview.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q9. What is the nature of the Senior Resident job at PMMMH Delhi?
faq.answer: The Senior Resident positions at Pt. Madan Mohan Malaviya Hospital are on an Ad-hoc basis. This means the appointments are temporary and for a specific period.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview for PMMMH Delhi Senior Resident posts going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the Pt. Madan Mohan Malaviya Hospital office in New Delhi. The specific address is PMMMH Delhi, New Delhi - 110017.
